question: Should QQBot adopt 16 MiB as its permanent inbound gateway-frame ceiling despite QQ not publishing an authoritative maximum event size?
rationale: The implementation and recovery path are sound, but selecting a fail-closed size limit trades protection against memory exhaustion for possible rejection of future valid QQ gateway events; repository review cannot safely choose that operational policy without channel-owner intent.

options.title: Confirm 16 MiB ceiling
options.body: Accept the proposed Mattermost-aligned headroom as QQBot’s channel policy and merge with the existing constructor and reconnect coverage.

options.title: Choose a QQ-specific limit
options.body: Replace 16 MiB with an owner-selected ceiling backed by authoritative QQ guidance or observed production requirements, then retain the same boundary and proof.

options.title: Defer the cap
options.body: Pause this PR until a QQBot owner can establish a supported inbound-event size policy rather than merging an undocumented permanent limit.

recommendation.title: Confirm 16 MiB ceiling
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed Mattermost-aligned headroom as QQBot’s channel policy and merge with the existing constructor and reconnect coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The available feature history places this person on the QQBot gateway architecture that owns inbound event handling and reconnect behavior.
